hooks.name: Verify Lab 1 Title Case Spelling
hooks.description: Ensures all code writes use Lab 1 Title Case for status values and no hardcoded secrets

action.prompt: Before writing this code, verify that any status string in response bodies (dicts with "status" key) uses Lab 1 Title Case: Authorized, Declined, Captured, Voided, Refunded, Failed, Pending. If you see lowercase status values like "authorized" or "declined" in a response dict, fix them to Title Case before proceeding. Also verify no WEBHOOK_SECRET default is hardcoded.
